data.name: Mounira
data.gender_notes: Mounira is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: In Arabic, Mounira means 'protector' or 'guardian'. This name holds a significant place in Islamic culture as it symbolizes the protective nature of Allah and the belief that He is always watching over us. The name Mounira carries the meaning “Protector, Guardian” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Mounira usually hope their child will grow to embody protector, guardian and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name of peace and protection.
data.etymology: Mounira belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Protector, Guardian.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Mounira total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.
